verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Canva's REST/Connect APIs, an OpenAPI description, SCIM, Admin and MCP surfaces. None of it mentions API versioning schemes, version pinning, or a documented deprecation or sunset policy. API lifecycle policy is a fair question for a SaaS platform with public APIs, so with no evidence the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
